name: MAX98357A I2S class-D amplifier breakout
blurb: Takes digital I2S audio from the microcontroller and drives a 4 to 8 ohm speaker directly at up to about 3 W; no DAC or separate amplifier is needed.

pins.name: LRC
pins.note: Left/right (word select) clock from the controller.

pins.name: GAIN
pins.note: Leave unconnected for 9 dB. To GND 12 dB, to VIN 6 dB, 100 kOhm to GND 15 dB, 100 kOhm to VIN 3 dB. Re-power after changing it.

pins.name: SD
pins.note: Shutdown and channel select. Leave alone: the board pulls it up, giving the (left+right)/2 mono mix at 5 V. Pull below 0.16 V to mute. A 3.3 V high selects left channel only.

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 2.5 to 5.5 V. Use 5 V from a supply that can give 800 mA for full volume; weak USB ports or a 3.3 V regulator will sag and click.

pins.name: SPK+
pins.note: Speaker terminal. Bridge-tied output: connect only to the speaker, never to ground or to another amp.

pins.name: SPK-
pins.note: Speaker terminal, not ground. Do not connect it to GND.
